attempts.prompt:
Use case: compositing. Create one high-resolution portrait-card fusion using exactly two inputs. Image1 is the sole authority for clothing, pose, hair, expression, light, and crop. Image2 provides only the mascot identity and anatomy. Transform the human anatomy into a smooth golden-yellow compact near-round mascot head and body with green-ringed black eyes and a source-matching mouth. Preserve the real source hair, including short grey/brown temple hair and actual brow hair, and retain the distinct short dark upper-lip moustache with a clean chin and no full beard. Maintain the serious closed-mouth expression and the exact source pose, crop, and lighting controls. Keep the olive/green peaked cap with red cap band, small central gold star/badge area, and dark visor. Preserve the olive/brown closed upright-collar military tunic with actual red/gold rectangular collar tabs and small gold front buttons or fastening areas beside the note. Ensure there are no open suit lapels, white shirt, or necktie; keep the true closed tunic and broad collar fit. The rounded chin must immediately meet the raised and broadened existing neckline, creating a very short broad neck transition with minimal throat exposure. Avoid any separate yellow neck shaft, pointed V funnel, pinched collar, neck rolls, floating collar, clipping, or cream belly bib. Ensure coherent front and rear collar overlap with contact shadows. Retain the complete tilted dark frame, opaque photographic backing in its exact original color, and the attached lower-right cream note with faint indistinct upper marks and actual overlap. All solid surfaces must remain opaque, with alpha only outside the complete card silhouette. Do not invent insignia, text, or accessories. Keep fine primary details that are indistinct understated.
FINAL EXACT SOURCE REQUIREMENT: Near-frontal mildly angled serious CLOSED-MOUTH military bust. OLIVE/GREEN peaked cap, RED cap band, small central GOLD star/badge area and dark visor; short GREY/BROWN temple hair and actual brow HAIR. ROUND clear brown/dark wire spectacles, distinct short DARK upper-lip MOUSTACHE and clean chin, no full beard. OLIVE/BROWN CLOSED upright-collar military tunic with actual RED/GOLD rectangular collar tabs and small GOLD front buttons/fastening areas beside note. No open suit lapels, white shirt or necktie; keep true closed tunic and broad collar fit. Exact source pose/crop/light controls, fine cap/collar engravings understated.
Preserve exact source head angle and expression. Whole yellow area above raised/broadened neckline is one compact near-round head, with clearly rounded chin immediately contacting the very short broad collar transition, no additional separate neck shaft or pointed V. Image1 is the exact original small card; Image2 identity only. Fine markings indistinct in Image1 must remain understated, not invented as a readable symbol.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.

Generated master replaces this visible cluster with two isolated round gold front buttons. The owner observation/prompt incorrectly simplified this region to gold buttons; preserve the original observation/actual prompt as history and repair the actual visible region without inventing fine engraving. The larger candidate matches cap/glasses/moustache only and has different visible collar detail/crop; it cannot establish hidden regalia. Correct closed olive tunic, red cap band/star, short grey temple/brow hair, round glasses, short dark moustache/clean chin, closed expression, compact round short-neck geometry, opaque backing and full frame/note are retained. Separate exact-fullsize builtin art repair required; not service retry or qualification. All raw original bytes retained.
